{{Quote|Now the Dread Masters' servants are loose in Section X, and I'm stuck here with this quack droid.|General Conlath|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''M-2VB''' was a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3639 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Carrick Station]], where he examined Republic [[General/Legends|General]] [[Conlath]], who suffered a mental trauma during an encounter with [[Dread Masters]] forces on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
M-2VB was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Update 1.5. M-2VB, Conlath and their quest were later removed from the game in Update 4.0, but brought back in Update 5.9.
